base_dockerfile_text:
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 ubuntu:24.04@sha256:008173c23f95b170204355c12626cb5a965d779a7e1283b09e9cffbb1bf33ca3
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake git ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN git config --system --add safe.directory '*'
RUN mkdir -p /workspace/repo && cd /workspace/repo \
    && git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat.git \
    && git fetch --depth 1 -q origin 57c7da69b78e3698e112a6b5da19d5109b8232d1 \
    && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
WORKDIR /workspace/repo
RUN cmake -S expat -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DEXPAT_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DEXPAT_BUILD_FUZZERS=OFF -DEXPAT_SHARED_LIBS=ON
RUN cmake --build build -j 4
LABEL repo="libexpat/libexpat" revision="57c7da69b78e3698e112a6b5da19d5109b8232d1" language="c"

spec.contamination: SWE-Sweep (2026-10-01) publishes these hidden tests and asks that they not be trained on; the bugs are libexpat fixes later than R_2_4_3 (2022-01), several of them public CVE fixes, so treat this task as high-contamination and track its results apart from injected and freshly mined tasks.
spec.name: libexpat-realbug-a
